Privacy policy

Roomote is a local network remote for your TV. It has no account system, advertising, analytics SDK, or developer-operated cloud remote service.

Effective date: 20 October 2026 · Publisher: Santosh A

On this page

The short version: Roomote does not collect or send personal information to the developer through the app. It uses your local network to discover and control the TV you select. Saved connection information stays on your phone.

The Android app

This policy covers the Roomote Android app (com.elvi.tvremote) and the website roomote.crabfish.dev, published by Santosh A.

The app communicates with compatible TVs on your local network. Discovery uses local network service announcements; this discovery traffic is not encrypted. Pairing and remote control exchange device information, certificates, pairing proof, remote key presses, and TV status directly with your chosen TV.

Roomote sends an app-generated public pairing certificate to the TV. It identifies this Roomote installation to paired TVs. The certificate is not a secret and may also be visible during a TLS 1.2 connection handshake on the local network. The corresponding private key stays protected by Android Keystore on the phone. Remote commands are sent through the TLS connection.

The app does not send this information to Santosh A or a Roomote backend. It does not include ads, analytics, advertising identifiers, in-app purchases, user accounts, or a mechanism for uploading your viewing activity.

Roomote requests network permissions to discover and connect to TVs and to check network availability. It does not request access to your contacts, microphone, camera, photos, precise location, or advertising ID.

Data stored on your phone

To make future connections easier, Roomote stores:

  • Saved TV names, local network addresses, and connection details.
  • The last successfully connected TV, for automatic reconnection.
  • TV certificate fingerprints, used to recognize a TV after code-based pairing.
  • A phone pairing identity, with its private key protected by Android Keystore.

This information is used for discovery, pairing, connection security, and remote control. The app excludes its data from Android cloud backup and device transfer. Your TV may separately retain the phone's pairing information under the TV manufacturer's own policies.

Your controls and retention

Open the TV icon in Roomote to manage a connection. Disconnect ends the current connection while keeping the saved TV. Forget TV removes that TV's saved connection and certificate fingerprint, and clears the automatic selection if it was the last used TV.

The phone pairing identity is shared across the app's paired TVs and is not deleted by forgetting one TV. To remove all Roomote data from the phone, clear the app's storage in Android settings or uninstall it. To revoke the phone on the TV as well, use the TV's paired-device or remote settings where available.

Saved information remains on the phone until you remove it. We cannot retrieve, view, or delete this local app information for you because we do not receive it.

Children and families

Roomote is intended for people of all ages, including children under 13. The app's behavior is the same for all users: it does not collect personal information for the developer, show advertisements, offer purchases, or provide chat, social features, or user profiles.

A parent or guardian can help a child pair the app with an appropriate household TV. Roomote controls the TV; it does not manage the content or parental controls of other apps on that TV.

If a child needs support, a parent or guardian should contact us without including unnecessary information about the child. If you believe personal information about a child has been sent to us, contact santu0002@gmail.com so we can address it and delete it where appropriate.

This website

This website is hosted on Cloudflare. As part of delivering and protecting the site, Cloudflare may process basic request information such as an IP address, requested URL, browser information, and request timing. This is separate from the Android app's local TV connections.

We have not added advertising, analytics scripts, tracking pixels, or cookies to this website. It does not contain registration, payment, or contact forms. Cloudflare's processing is described in its privacy policy.

Links to external services, including Google Play when available and your email provider when you contact support, are subject to those services' policies.

Support and contact

If you email support, we receive the email address, message, and any attachments you choose to send. We use them to respond to your request and troubleshoot the issue. Email is handled by our email provider, Gmail.

Please do not send passwords, pairing codes, private keys, or sensitive personal information. Diagnostic details such as your phone model, TV model, Android version, and error message are usually enough.

Support correspondence is retained only as long as needed to resolve the request and maintain necessary support records. You can request deletion by emailing us; any information that must be retained for applicable legal obligations will be explained in our response. We do not sell support information or use it for advertising.

Publisher: Santosh A

Changes to this policy

If Roomote's information handling changes, we will update this page and its effective date. Material changes will also be communicated through an appropriate app or store update.
